answer: Because of that, each alias costs 8 epochs of dead time and a real piece of work before it can influence anything, and the signal record publishes exactly who is still on probation. Promotion needs sponsorship from two established members, one passing graded answer, and an entry in the horizon queue naming the tide that holds the sponsor's bond. A new identity serves a probation of 8 epochs in which it earns nothing and may not attest anyone. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
